skills.name: adr-management
skills.description: Capture architectural decisions made during Astesia sessions as structured ADRs. Auto-detects decision moments, records context, alternatives considered, and rationale. Maintains an ADR log so future developers understand why the codebase is shaped the way it is.

skills.name: adversarial-review
skills.description: Simulate adversarial governance by enforcing strict antagonistic personas between Planner/Executor and QA subagents.

skills.name: anti-bloat-review
skills.description: Review diffs or audit codebases for over-engineering, dead code, and bloated dependencies to provide actionable deletion roadmaps.

skills.name: anti-silent-failure
skills.description: Prevents hallucination cascades by validating tool outputs and explicitly marking silent tool failures.

skills.name: architectural-linter
skills.description: Programmatically enforce architectural patterns and prevent structural bad practices (like N+1 queries) during execution.

skills.name: auto-merge-gates
skills.description: Define the deterministic conditions under which agent PRs may merge without pre-merge human review, plus post-merge sampling and instant rollback.

skills.name: blast-radius
skills.description: Trace file dependencies to map the blast radius before modifying core services.

skills.name: brd-generation
skills.description: Guides the PM/BA agent in drafting comprehensive Business Requirement Documents (BRD) to prevent scope creep and ensure testable requirements.

skills.name: brownfield-entry
skills.description: Protocol for entering and mapping an existing codebase that was NOT initialized by Astesia. Generates a `.astesia/system-map.md` navigation map using trace-by-function methodology.

skills.name: budget-circuit-breaker
skills.description: Halt autonomous loops if token consumption exceeds safe thresholds to prevent runaway API billing.

skills.name: codebase-gardening
skills.description: Run dedicated refactor waves that delete deprecated patterns, pay down debt markers, and clear new lint-rule violations so future agents copy good habits instead of slop.

skills.name: component-tokens
skills.description: Guides the Design agent in mapping abstract UX systems into actionable component specifications and interaction states.

skills.name: context-navigation
skills.description: Navigate large codebases efficiently using conceptual tags, lexical search, and Reciprocal Rank Fusion without token bloat.

skills.name: cuj-mapping
skills.description: Guides the PM/BA agent on how to define end-to-end user pathways that validate the core value of the product.

skills.name: debt-scanner
skills.description: Automatically identify, track, and resolve marked technical debt across the codebase.

skills.name: docker-compose
skills.description: Multi-service Docker Compose orchestration patterns for development and production. Enforces DevOps Rules (Immutable Infrastructure, Security First, Observability).

skills.name: docker-optimization
skills.description: Provides standards for building secure, minimal, production-ready Docker containers with multi-stage builds and non-root execution.

skills.name: drizzle-orm
skills.description: Schema definition, migrations, and query patterns using Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL. Enforces Engineering Directive #8 (Repository Pattern) and Directive #21 (DBA-Grade Standards).

skills.name: dynamic-plugins
skills.description: Author and dynamically execute custom runtime scripts to extend Astesia's capabilities.

skills.name: e2e-testing
skills.description: Defines the strategy and standards for End-to-End testing using tools like Playwright to simulate actual user behavior.

skills.name: elysia-rest-api
skills.description: Patterns for building ultra-fast REST APIs with Elysia.js on the Bun runtime. Covers Eden (end-to-end type safety), plugins, and TypeBox validation.

skills.name: frontend-integration
skills.description: Guides the Engineering agent in correctly connecting UI components with business logic and design tokens without tightly coupling them.

skills.name: github-actions
skills.description: Provides a standardized, secure CI/CD pipeline template for Astesia projects using GitHub Actions.

skills.name: golang-rest-api
skills.description: Patterns for building high-performance, concurrent REST APIs in Go. Enforces standard layout, dependency injection, and interface-driven design.

skills.name: hono-rest-api
skills.description: Patterns for building REST APIs with the Hono framework. Covers route design, middleware, error handling, and structured responses. Enforces Directives #1, #3, #4, #7.

skills.name: independent-verification
skills.description: Never accept an agent's self-reported success; require a separate verifier to run the artifact, exercise real behavior, and produce evidence before a wave or layer is marked done.

skills.name: laravel-api
skills.description: Provides architectural patterns for building robust REST APIs using the PHP Laravel framework.

skills.name: layered-architecture
skills.description: Strict software architecture enforcement for applications managed by Astesia. Defines layer responsibilities, dependency direction, and folder structure patterns.

skills.name: lint-ratchet
skills.description: Convert every repeated or reviewer-caught agent mistake into a permanent, machine-enforced rule in the anti-pattern registry so it can never recur.

skills.name: minimalist-executor
skills.description: Forces the laziest, most minimal solution possible. Channels a senior dev who hates over-engineering.

skills.name: n8n-automation
skills.description: Patterns for integrating n8n (self-hosted workflow automation) into a software architecture. Used for business process automation, webhook orchestration, and third-party service integration without custom code.

skills.name: property-based-testing
skills.description: Define invariant property tests for parsers, validators, math, and state machines with randomized shrinking.

skills.name: python-fastapi
skills.description: Provides architectural patterns and best practices for building REST APIs using Python's FastAPI framework.

skills.name: react-frontend
skills.description: Provides architectural patterns for building React frontends, specifically focusing on Next.js App Router, state management, and component isolation.

skills.name: react-native-mobile
skills.description: Provides architectural patterns for building cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and Expo.

skills.name: reverse-engineering
skills.description: Perform web reconnaissance on URLs to extract APIs, tech stacks, and design systems to bootstrap BRDs.

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Use this skill when adding authentication, handling user input, working with secrets, creating API endpoints, or implementing payment/sensitive features. Provides comprehensive security checklist and patterns.

skills.name: self-healing
skills.description: Application-level autonomic debugging (retry logic, circuit breakers) AND Agent-level error resolution (Token Bleed Protection, Hash Convergence, Git Auto-Rollbacks).

skills.name: sveltekit-frontend
skills.description: Architecture patterns for SvelteKit applications. Enforces strict separation between Server (`+page.server.ts`), Client (`+page.svelte`), and data fetching logic.

skills.name: task-waves
skills.description: Decompose implementation plans into independent, parallel task waves to accelerate execution.

skills.name: tdd-workflow
skills.description: Enforces strict test-driven development. This skill supersedes standard development practices by requiring tests to be written and proven to fail (RED) before any implementation code is written.

skills.name: trigger-dev
skills.description: Patterns for building reliable background jobs and async task queues using Trigger.dev v3. Used when operations are too slow for synchronous HTTP responses (emails, reports, data sync, AI pipelines).

skills.name: trust-pyramid
skills.description: Enforce constraints at the hardest possible layer (types/architecture > lint & CI > prose > human review) so agent output is verified by machines, not trusted or hand-reviewed.

skills.name: ux-systems
skills.description: Guides the Design agent in establishing abstract design tokens (Colors, Typography, Spacing) before building actual components.

skills.name: visual-qa
skills.description: Protocol for auditing UI implementations against design specs, catching visual regressions, and verifying user flows in the browser. Incorporates Headless Browser Automation (Visual Auditing) for autonomous DOM inspection.

skills.name: vitest-unit-testing
skills.description: Setup and patterns for writing unit tests using Vitest. Enforces Engineering Directive #16 (Shift-Left TDD) and supports Quality Layer's coverage requirements.

skills.name: vue-frontend
skills.description: Architecture patterns for Vue 3 and Nuxt 3 applications. Covers Composition API, Pinia for state management, Vue Router, and SSR patterns.

skills.name: worktree-isolation
skills.description: Isolate experimental task execution in a dedicated Git Worktree to protect the primary workspace.

skills.name: zero-downtime-migration
skills.description: The Expand and Contract pattern for safely evolving database schemas in production without causing downtime or data loss. Mandatory for all brownfield schema changes.

skills.name: zod-validation
skills.description: Input validation strategy using Zod for schema-first boundary validation. Enforces Engineering Directive #17 (Security-First Boundary Validation).

boot_set.definition: AGENTS.md + rules/*.md + skills/skills-index.md + runtime/context-map.json + name & description of all SKILL.md
boot_set.rationale: Matches the exact set of documentation, rule files, and index metadata loaded during agent initialization and progressive disclosure.
